summary: Rolling previous-release compatibility baselines and published archive inputs

compatibility.detail: Compatibility evidence now compares the current candidate with the previous published stable release instead of permanently historical sources. Fleet CI uses the checksum-verified published native binary; historical messaging uses channel source at the same pinned release commit. This changes test coverage, not runtime wire, client or harness contracts, and does not establish arbitrary mixed-fleet or downgrade support.

manual.detail: Release automation opens a postpublication baseline maintenance PR against main. A human must review and merge it before the next stable candidate is published; publication does not enable auto-merge or enrollment. CI rejects pins more than one published stable release behind unless exception_reason records an explicit temporary older hold. Publisher Actions permissions must allow pull request creation and workflow dispatch. See docs/ci.md for repin and postpublication recovery commands.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change. Published release sources remain immutable; baseline maintenance is a subsequent main change.
